raw_resume.summary: QA Engineer with 2+ years of professional experience in embedded systems and firmware testing. Seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply technical foundation in C, C++, and embedded development toward scalable systems and algorithm-driven problem-solving.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line.
Automated 150 firmware regression cases with Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle from 3 days to 1 day.
Logged and triaged defects in JIRA with firmware developers during 2-week sprints.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project during career break: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with data structures (linked lists, trees, graphs, hash tables) and algorithm design (sorting, searching, dynamic programming) through coding practice or a systems project.
Study and implement distributed systems concepts (consensus, replication, eventual consistency) in a personal or professional project to demonstrate scalable system thinking.
Deepen object-oriented design skills by refactoring or building a multi-module C++ application that demonstrates encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.
Consider a role or project that bridges QA and backend development, such as test infrastructure or performance testing for distributed services, to transition credibly into SDE.
raw_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded background is strong, but the SDE role emphasizes data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and OOP design—areas not yet evidenced in your profile. A deliberate upskilling project or role transition is needed to close this gap.
